name: pi-studio
description: A local daemon that owns pi agents: a workspace is a folder, a thread on its board is an agent.

scripts.precheck: node -e "if(!require('fs').existsSync('node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc')){console.error('pi-studio: npm run check needs the dev dependency, so run npm ci once. The daemon itself needs nothing.');process.exit(1)}"
